name: sv_to_x_languages_benchmark
description: A multilingual machine-translation benchmark that evaluates models' ability to translate from Swedish into a variety of target languages. It measures translation quality across language pairs and scripts and is intended for comparing MT and multilingual LLM performance. The benchmark provides parallel test sets and typical MT evaluation scores.
evaluation_method: BLEU (automatic MT metrics such as BLEU/SacreBLEU; may also report chrF or TER)
reputation: A niche Hugging Face community dataset for Swedish-centric multilingual translation tasks; modest adoption in specialized MT evaluations.
